exposure: Women in the 'poorer' household wealth category
cohort: 9977 women in Colombia who answered the woman-only module of the 2015 Demographic and Health Survey
finding: Markers of socioeconomic status are associated with cesarean delivery overuse in Colombia, as well as the number and timing of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women in the 'poorer' household wealth category were more likely to have emergency and two or more cesarean deliveries.
